model: Claude Code agent mode, fresh subagent

exemptions: except thereout any lands which may lie within the corporate limits of any city, town, village or district municipality or any lands which may be hereinafter incorporated therein

steps.start: the southwest corner of Lot 226, Group 1, NWD
steps.quote: Commencing at the southwest corner of Lot 226, Group 1, NWD, being a point on the high water mark of the waters of Port Moody, on the northerly shore thereof
thence northerly along the westerly boundary of said Lot 226 to the northwest corner thereof

steps.until: the northeast corner of said Lot 227
steps.quote: thence easterly along the northerly boundaries of Lots 226 and 227 to the northeast corner of said Lot 227
thence southerly along the easterly boundary of said Lot 227 to the northerly boundary of Lot 350
thence easterly along said northerly boundary of Lot 350 to the northeast corner thereof
thence easterly, northerly and easterly along the northerly, westerly and northerly boundaries of Lot 348 to the northeast corner thereof

steps.until: the northeast corner of said Section 33
steps.quote: thence northerly along the easterly boundaries of Sections 16, 21, 28 and 33, Township 39, WCM, to the northeast corner of said Section 33

steps.start: the northeast corner of said Section 33
steps.until: the northeast corner of the District Municipality of North Vancouver
steps.quote: and from the northeast corner of said Section 33 in a straight line to the northeast corner of the District Municipality of North Vancouver

steps.feature: Indian Arm, Burrard Inlet, and the waters of Port Moody
steps.until: a point 365 m (1 200 feet) due North of the intersection of the centreline of North Road with the high water mark of the waters of Port Moody, on the southerly shore thereof
steps.quote: thence in a general southerly and easterly direction along the middle lines of Indian Arm, Burrard Inlet, and the waters of Port Moody to a point 365 m (1 200 feet) due North of the intersection of the centreline of North Road with the high water mark of the waters of Port Moody, on the southerly shore thereof

steps.until: a point due South of the aforesaid southwest corner of Lot 226
steps.quote: thence due East to a point due South of the aforesaid southwest corner of Lot 226

steps.until: said southeast corner of Lot 226, being point of commencement
steps.quote: thence North to said southeast corner of Lot 226, being point of commencement
